procedure_name: Refund of Unused / Spoiled E-Stamp Paper Duty
summary: Procedure to recover up to 90% of stamp duty paid on cancelled property purchase transactions or spoiled stamp papers.
estimated_total_cost: 10% statutory deduction from total stamp value

steps.title: Preserve original e-stamp certificate
steps.description: Ensure application is submitted within statutory 6 months from e-stamp certificate purchase date.

steps.title: Affidavit of cancellation
steps.description: Execute sworn affidavit before notary stating reasons for cancellation and that deed was never executed/registered.

steps.title: Sub-registrar non-registration certificate
steps.description: Sub-Registrar inspects archives and issues certificate confirming stamp was never used for registration.

steps.title: Submit refund claim to Collector
steps.description: Submit application to District Collector (Stamps) with bank account details for Direct Benefit Transfer.

steps.title: Order of refund and bank credit
steps.description: Collector approves refund deducting 10% statutory fee; amount credited to buyer's bank account.
